name: 14B Native Feasibility Preflight Design + Capacity Gap Analysis
head: 316fa4004

14b_feasibility_hypothesis.load: Likely succeeds — ~8-9GB weights fit in available RAM with headroom
14b_feasibility_hypothesis.generation: Likely fails at c=4096+ due to KV/context pressure; c=2048 edge of possibility
key_unknowns: Does model load actually succeed (RSS within estimate)?
Does generation at c=2048 stay stable (swap delta < 250MB)?
Is failure mode KV/context (context SDI helps) or base weight footprint (capacity-first PRT required)?
Does Ollama internal KV management work at all on 14B, or does it fail at load?

stage_0.name: Disk/model availability check
stage_0.purpose: Confirm model exists and safe to pull before any pull
actions: List available Ollama models — find 14B candidate
Record model name, file size, quantization

stage_1.name: System readiness check
stage_1.purpose: Confirm hardware is in clean state before model load

stage_2.name: Model pull and load (no generation)
stage_2.purpose: Pull model and observe load behavior without generation pressure

stage_3.name: Tiny generation at c=1024
stage_3.purpose: First generation test with maximum safety margin
stage_3.prompt: Return only the capital of France.

stage_4.name: Short instruction-following at c=2048
stage_4.purpose: Confirm model can follow instructions coherently at target context
stage_4.prompt: Write a 3-sentence summary of: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the riverbank.

stage_5.name: Exact retrieval at c=2048
stage_5.purpose: Confirm model can retrieve exact embedded string under noisy context
stage_5.prompt: [2000 char filler] + tracking ID SDI-2026-Q2-v011 + question

progression_rules: Stage 1 must pass before Stage 2 (model pull)
No c=4096 in first 14B preflight phase
No c=8192 in first 14B preflight phase
Any abort stops preflight and reports classification

candidate_model_criteria.preferred_family: qwen (qwen2.5:14b) — consistent with prior eval models
candidate_model_criteria.primary_candidate: qwen2.5:14b — available in Ollama registry, ~9GB, Q4_K_M default

memory_budget.note: All KV estimates are approximate. Actual KV depends on Ollama internal management, head dimensions, layer count. Estimates are directionally correct but not precision.

pre_run_checklist: no other large processes consuming RAM

classification_scheme.LOAD_FAIL: Model cannot be pulled/loaded. OOM during load. Disk insufficient. → Capacity-first PRT required; context SDI irrelevant.
classification_scheme.LOAD_PASS_GEN_TIMEOUT: Model loads but generation times out/hangs. → Speed issue, not memory. May be hardware limitation.
classification_scheme.GEN_PASS_SWAP_RISK: Generation succeeds but swap grows >250MB. → Context SDI could help; capacity-first PRT possibly.
classification_scheme.GEN_PASS_STABLE: Generation succeeds with stable swap (<50MB delta) and coherent output. → 14B feasible at c=2048. Probe c=4096.
classification_scheme.CONTEXT_LIMITED: c=2048 works; c=4096 unsafe by budget. → Context SDI may extend range; capacity-first PRT not required if KV only issue.
classification_scheme.CAPACITY_PRT_REQUIRED: Base weights/load leave too little headroom even at c=2048. → Capacity-first PRT must be designed.
classification_scheme.CONTEXT_SDI_SUFFICIENT: Base model loads with headroom; only KV/context pressure is risky. → Context SDI primary solution.

recommended_next_phase: Phase 28G: 14B model availability + disk/RAM preflight — Stage 0 only, confirm available 14B candidates and sizes; no model pull without explicit Matt approval; no generation without explicit Matt approval
